message: 理

name: Misa
message: 「That concludes today's morning practice. Good work, everyone.」
Misa's clear voice echoes through the early morning chapel.
A few moments later, the crisp atmosphere softens, and lively chatter along with impressions of the new hymn fill the air.

name: Synn
message: 「You're amazing, Misa. Even though it was our first joint practice, you conducted brilliantly. And you're great at teaching singing, too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, of course I am. After all, I spend my days supporting a certain unreliable Student Council President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's so like you, Misa.」

name: Azel
message: 「...It's a good song.」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan. This turned out even better than I expected.」

name: Misa
message: 「To receive such praise from you, Onee-sama, I'm deeply moved!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It really is a lovely song, isn't it? Thanks to you, it looks like I'll be making another fond memory with Rii-a. Much obliged, Vice President.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-What the heck is Bubuzuke doing here?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san, participation in the Holy Night Festival choir is voluntary, you know? I want everyone in the academy to come.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, but Bubuzuke is practically the incarnation of wagashi, right? She's got nothing to do with Christmas!」

name: Shio
message: 「Um, Nanaka-dono... By that logic, would I, as a shrine maiden, also be unable to participate?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shio-chan is totally okay!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh, my. Are there people who get special treatment here, and people who don't?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「With a captain like that at the helm, the Sweet Club really doesn't amount to much, does it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wrong, it's the Sweets Club!! Stop getting it wrong on purpose!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Hey-ssu! Good work-ssu. Cristelis-senpai, that was an awesome song. I'm gonna come to practice tomorrow too-ssu.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yumil, good timing! Beat up Bubuzuke for me! That's a president's order!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Y-Yuugiri-senpai, that's basically power harassment-ssu.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like hell I'm gonna let the likes of the Wagashi Club get a head start on us!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan. Forget a head start, they've already left you way in the dust. Look, check that out.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「These are Hanamura's special throat lozenges. Rii-a, open wide and say 'aah'.」

name: Ria
message: 「Aah... nom, nom.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nom, nom, roll, roll... It's sweet, yet my throat feels so cool and refreshed. What a pleasant sensation.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「This candy is made with fine wasanbon sugar, so it has a refined flavor that Western sweets--which are merely sweet--could never imitate.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What the heck!? The two bigwigs of the Student Council have fallen right into her Kyoto-style trap!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though I'm the president, I'm not counted among them?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin, Yumil, it's time for our counterattack!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I got these herb candies from Fuyuka-san over at Chocolat l'Or. She said they're super soothing on the throat.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! Eat up, eat up! Come on, come on!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, nom, nom...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...He's hopeless, this guy is totally hopeless!」

name: Misa
message: 「Teehee.」

name: Yumil
message: 「Asukai... Having mischievous seniors sure is rough on both of us, huh. Here, have a candy.」

name: Shio
message: 「Nom, nom... Oho, this is not the sweetness of ordinary sugar. Hmm...?」

name: Shio
message: 「I perceive this is the result of blending several medicinal herbs in an exquisite balance.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nice going, Yumil! Now, pass out those herb candies to everyone instead of those clunky hard candies--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Here you go, a delicious, delicious little candy for you. Say 'aah'」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Chomp. Nom, nom... It's true--it's sweet, yet it melts so smoothly and feels all cool and refreshing!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Sacchin!? You traitor! Cast everything aside and fight!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehh? As long as it's yummy, who cares what it is? Let's just relax and enjoy them.」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yuugiri-senpai... Personally, I think Sacchin-senpai's got a point, y'know?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Expected nothing less from the second-generation leader. Truth be told, Sacchin-han is the shadow boss of the Sweets Club, isn't she?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not Sweets, it's Suite! ...Wait, huh?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Sacchin, how about joining the Wagashi Club? Even a trial membership would be lovely, you know?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm, what should I do~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Watch out, Sacchin! Run for it!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Won't you join us as well, Nanaka? I happen to have gotten my hands on some wonderful tea sweets made with buckwheat flour, you see?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-Buckwheat flour... You don't mean...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, she's tempted.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urgh... I-I won't give in! Not when I have to live up to Fuyuka-san's expectations!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If it has come to this, then it is time to bring out Jiiya's homemade genkotsu candy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, we're good on that.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Noo, I'll pass on that too.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahahaha. You two are totally on the same wavelength, Akane-chan and Nanaka-chan.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sniff... Everyone, why are you all so opposed to it? Even though Tennouji-san looks so delighted.」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Eek?! M-Me? You really threw that at me out of nowhere.」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Ummm... I've got business in the confessional, so see ya! My family line's real good at slipping into the next room, you know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She left...」

name: Eddie
message: 「'Genkotsu'--I like how rugged that name sounds. Give me one.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yay, here you go♪」

name: Eddie
message: 「Mmmph-grmph.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, that's four of them.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Two is plenty~」

name: Eddie
message: 「Mmph-mmph-mmph-mmph.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eddy, you really are...」

name: Eddie
message: 「Mmph, mmph, mmph, mmph?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-See, it doesn't melt at all, right?」

name: Eddie
message: 「Mmph, mmph, mmph, mmph...」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, Eddy, even if you look at me with teary eyes, there's nothing I can do about it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eddy-san left, too. He must be going to the classroom to review his lessons, how admirable.」

name: Misa
message: 「What if Mukaibara-kun doesn't show up tomorrow...」

name: Synn
message: 「Participation is voluntary, so we can't force him.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, I think you should be more worried about what happens if a huge crowd shows up instead.」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez, stop flattering me.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm serious. I mean, it's gotten such great reviews.」

name: Synn
message: 「Word about the hymns will spread during break, so a ton of interested people are bound to come after school.」

name: Ria
message: 「I think so too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, Onee-sama... B-But if that happens--」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, wrap up your afternoon Student Council duties early and focus on the hymns.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. We've got Synn-kun here for the Student Council, after all. Right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah! For the sake of the Holy Night Festival too, Misa has to focus on singing!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, the Treasurer is juggling the Sweets Club as well. Vice President, please go ahead and practice your hymns. It's what they call 'fighting amphibians'」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank you, everyone...!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah, that's the warning bell. Why don't we just stay here and chat all day long?」

name: Misa
message: 「Okay, everyone, please clear out. I'm locking up the chapel.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nunaah?! Nana-chan, it's not too late yet. Go for a stolen love! If you follow my script, it'll totally work out!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, I got it, so let's head back to the classroom together, okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「...What is a 'stolen love'?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'll teach you hands-on, hips-on, step-by-step, so come on, Azel-chan!」
Everyone leaves the church in twos and threes.
The only ones left behind are Misa, who's in charge of locking up, and me, keeping her company.

name: Misa
message: 「All the windows are locked... there. That should do it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-What is it! Don't look at me with that smile like Father's.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I was just thinking how gallant and lovely you look when you're singing, too, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph! Flattering me won't get you anything at all, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, your tongue came out, see? Mmh.」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmph--slurp!? Nnh... mfu... nnh...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hah, hah, haaaah--. ...S-Sakura-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Can you kiss... your dad like that?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-Idiot...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well then! I have class, so I'll head on ahead, okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「I have class too! Escort me to my classroom!」

name: Synn
message: 「Finally, it's lunch break.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Demon Lord, what's for grub today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Dumplings made from Milky's milk thickened with starch and salt, plus butter and cheese, and for dessert--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Dessert is yogurt... Wait, isn't that all homemade dairy products?!」

name: Misa
message: 「I challenge you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa, you're in the class next door, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right, I came over from the class next door!」

name: Synn
message: 「Speed-eating contests are bad for your health. You have to chew your food well and eat slowly.」

name: Misa
message: 「I didn't come here for that kind of match! Just shut up and come with me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whew-whew♪」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Man, you two are making me jealous~」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's nothing like that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, come on now. Judging by the size of that, you brought enough bento for two people, didn't you.」

name: Misa
message: 「I simply made too much!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm? There are two pairs of chopsticks too, aren't there~」

name: Misa
message: 「Kieee! I told you that's not it, we're going to have a match!」

name: Synn
message: 「Where to?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's a secret...!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oops, I've got plans with Hikki to grab dim sum. I'll take my leave now.」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank goodness. There's no wind today, so it's nice and warm.」
We sit side by side on a bench in the courtyard. Perhaps because few people eat lunch outside in the dead of winter, there's nobody else around.

name: Synn
message: 「Plus the sky is completely clear. Eating a bento outside on a day like this makes it taste even better.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. Though even on cloudy or rainy days, I still love bentos, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「...Ever since I was little, Mother was always busy with work.」

name: Misa
message: 「So on days when classes ended in the morning or on holidays, there would be a lunch bento left on the table at home.」

name: Misa
message: 「There was always a note attached, saying, 'Be sure to wash your hands properly' and 'Say itadakimasu before you eat'」

name: Misa
message: 「Whenever I saw Mother's bento, I would mysteriously feel so happy, and it tasted wonderful...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I get it. I've had similar experiences myself.」

name: Synn
message: 「Getting to eat a bento on a day that wasn't even a field trip felt fun and made me proud, giving me a secret sense of superiority over everyone else.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hehe, me too.」

name: Misa
message: 「I wanted to recreate that bento... so as soon as I entered middle school, I had Mother teach me how to make it.」

name: Synn
message: 「And today, you're letting me eat it, right.」

name: Misa
message: 「Gasp!? N-No!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Oh, right, we haven't said itadakimasu yet.」

name: Misa
message: 「That too, but...」

name: Misa
message: 「I didn't bring any chopsticks for you, you know!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, I see two chopstick cases, though?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah...!? N-Never mind that! I'm the type who uses chopsticks with both hands!」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right.」

name: Misa
message: 「Now then, are you ready? Let's have a contest!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You've got some nerve pulling a stunt like that this morning. At the church, doing something so...!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Are you mad about the kiss?」

name: Misa
message: 「It took me three years to finally make tamagoyaki just like Mother's.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「*Glance, glance*... N-Nobody's around, right.」
Ignoring my question, Misa brought a piece of tamagoyaki to her small mouth and--

name: Misa
message: 「Fwaa...」
Holding the tamagoyaki between her lips, she turned her face toward me.

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You want me to eat it mouth-to-mouth?」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's thousands of times more embarrassing than a normal kiss!」

name: Misa
message: 「Mfufu... fwaa!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you for the food... mmh!」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmh, mfuu... mmh, chuu...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmph...」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I ate it. That makes this contest a tie, right.」

name: Misa
message: 「There are still 24 side dishes left.」

name: Misa
message: 「Teehee.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. To put it crudely, the Demon Generals led by Bylous are nothing more than a ragtag bunch. Their foundation is fragile, and their chain of command is a complete mess...」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's a problem even more basic than that. When the guy at the top hasn't made his goal clear, unity is just a pipe dream.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Though thanks to that, the Demon Lord was able to pick off the Demon Generals one by one.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Each individual Demon General possesses respectable abilities. Had they launched a simultaneous assault on the Crusaders, they likely would have won with ease.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, this tactic--one anyone could think of--has not been adopted thus far.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You've got a vague hunch about it too, don't you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You mean regarding Sakura-kun last night?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...An upper limit to his power as the Demon Lord has begun to show.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even so, it's an overwhelming awakening that none of the other guys could ever hope to reach, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even so, I had estimated that Sakura-kun's growth was limitless. In fact, that was true up until two days ago.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ain't that a good thing? Knowing the limits of your own power is important.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, it'll probably be a long while before that good-natured Demon Lord gets that strong anyway.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Two days ago, after finishing Sakura-kun's training, I destroyed the magic circle amplifying Re-Crea.」

name: Melilot
message: 「And almost simultaneously, an upper limit appeared on the Demon Lord's power... I cannot believe the alignment of these two signs is a coincidence.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... It's been a while since I've had the pleasure of an exchange like this.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Would you be willing to tell me?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You... while probing into the Demon Lord's power, you're trying to test whether I'm the real deal at the same time, aren't you?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You don't need to overthink it--at the root, it's simple, see?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Magic power and Spirit Power... Despite being fundamentally different things, you can see commonalities in their attributes, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Elemental magic has massive effects, but it has a flaw, and that is--」

name: Melilot
message: 「That there is always an elemental magic that serves as its weakness.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, that's the law of the Demon World.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Talented individuals can cast magic by combining multiple attributes, yet even those patterns are finite. They remain within the bounds of reason.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's easy to forget when faced with overwhelming power, but the Demon Lord ain't an exception either, ya know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Each attribute keeps the others in check, and each attribute nurtures the others.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That shares similarities with nature in the Human World.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Quick on the uptake, aren't ya. That's why it's called Re-Crea.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Though that's strictly a hypothesis.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then let us continue cooperating with Sakura-kun and proceed with the Demon Lord's training.」

name: Paqy
message: 「More importantly, what do you say? As you are now, you could finish off the Demon Lord.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wanna catch her and dissect her? The pursuit of truth would sure as hell be fascinating.」

name: Melilot
message: 「A tempting jest, though I have no hobby of plucking Chinese milk vetch blossoms.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Guess we both end up like that when we've lived this long.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh...」
